convert_pose_to_translation_quaternion: convert a 4x4 SE3 pose matrix to a 7-element translation and quaternion vector using pose_to_tq
convert_translation_quaternion_to_pose: convert a 7-element translation and quaternion vector back to a 4x4 SE3 pose matrix using tq_to_pose
compute_se3_exponential_map: compute the SE3 exponential map from a 6D Lie algebra tangent vector to a 4x4 transformation matrix using se3_exp
invert_se3_transformation: compute the inverse of a 4x4 SE3 transformation matrix using invertSE3 with transposed rotation and negated translation
compute_skew_symmetric_matrix: compute the 3x3 skew-symmetric matrix from a 3D vector using skew_symmetric for cross product operations
